answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy requires each new identity to post a 500 POA time-locked bond that unlocks only after a fixed 21-day horizon no payment can shorten. During the wait the identity must emit a unique low-rate beacon signal every 4 hours; any miss voids the bond. A dune of clone accounts therefore ties capital for the full unshortenable delay on every name, so farms cannot amortize the waiting cost across parallel identities.
